import pandas as pd

# Recreate the dataframe from the provided table
data = {
    'Tournament': ['Australian Open', 'French Open', 'Wimbledon', 'US Open', 'Win–Loss', 
                   'Indian Wells Masters', 'Miami Masters', 'Monte-Carlo Masters', 'Rome Masters', 
                   'Madrid Masters', 'Canada Masters', 'Cincinnati Masters', 'Shanghai Masters', 
                   'Paris Masters', 'Hamburg Masters', 'Win–Loss', 'Titles–Finals', 'Year End Ranking'],
    '2004': ['A', '2R', 'A', 'A', '1–1', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'Not Masters Series', 'A', 'A', '0–0', '0–0', '129'],
    '2005': ['2R', '1R', '2R', '1R', '2–4', 'A', 'A', '1R', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'Not Masters Series', 'A', 'A', '0–1', '0–0', '91'],
    '2006': ['2R', '1R', '2R', '1R', '2–4', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'Not Masters Series', 'A', '2R', '1–1', '0–0', '68'],
    '2007': ['2R', '2R', '1R', '1R', '2–4', '3R', '2R', '3R', 'A', 'LQ', 'A', 'LQ', 'Not Masters Series', 'LQ', '1R', '4–4', '0–0', '90'],
    '2008': ['3R', '2R', '3R', '2R', '6–4', '2R', '1R', 'LQ', 'A', 'LQ', 'A', 'A', 'Not Masters Series', 'LQ', 'A', '1–2', '0–0', '62'],
    '2009': ['2R', '1R', '2R', '2R', '3–4', '1R', '1R', 'A', 'LQ', '1R', '1R', '3R', '1R', 'A', 'Not Masters Series', '2–6', '1–1', '41'],
    '2010': ['1R', '2R', '1R', '2R', '2–4', '4R', '2R', '1R', '3R', '3R', 'A', 'A', 'QF', 'A', 'Not Masters Series', '11–6', '1–2', '33'],
    '2011': ['3R', '3R', '2R', '2R', '6–4', '2R', '2R', '2R', '1R', '3R', 'A', '1R', '2R', '2R', 'Not Masters Series', '5–8', '0–0', '39'],
    '2012': ['1R', '1R', '2R', '2R', '2–4', '3R', '2R', 'A', '2R', '2R', 'A', 'A', 'Q2', '1R', 'Not Masters Series', '5–5', '0–0', '76'],
    '2013': ['1R', '1R', '1R', '1R', '0–4', 'A', 'A', 'A', 'A', '1R', 'A', 'A', 'A', '1R', 'Not Masters Series', '0–2', '0–2', '62'],
    '2014': ['2R', '', '', '', '1–1', 'A', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''],
    'W–L': ['9–10', '6–10', '7–9', '5–9', '27–38', '8–6', '3–6', '2–3', '3–3', '5–5', '0–1', '2–2', '4–3', '1–3', '1–2', '29–35', '2–5', '']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Filter to the row containing the overall Win–Loss per year (the first 'Win–Loss' row)
win_loss_row = df[df['Tournament'] == 'Win–Loss'].iloc[0]

# Extract the Win–Loss values for each year column (2004 to 2014)
years = [str(y) for y in range(2004, 2015)]
win_loss_by_year = {}
for year in years:
    val = win_loss_row[year]
    if isinstance(val, str) and '–' in val:
        w, l = map(int, val.split('–'))
        win_loss_by_year[year] = w

# Find years where wins > 10
answer_years = [year for year, wins in win_loss_by_year.items() if wins > 10]

# Return the answer as a single string with years separated by commas
answer = ', '.join(answer_years)
